t: Animated bubble charts of world development data that run in a browser.
steps: Open the Gapminder Tools page in a web browser.
Read the Gapminder Tools Guide in PDF.
Pick two indicators and press play to animate the chart.
Download one indicator as a CSV or XLSX file.
Ask IT about Gapminder Tools Offline for Windows, Mac, or Linux. The vendor says it works without internet and updates when connected.
Check the full datasets on GitHub as CSV files.
Add attribution to any chart that students share.
